headline: Seven macOS AppleScript detectors added; RMM variations land across five endpoint rules
summary_md:
- **Eight detectors added**, seven of them AppleScript rules covering macOS credential, wallet, clipboard and exfiltration abuse.
- **Five detectors withdrawn**, including both Email-module URL-popularity detectors and the Slack Connect invite detector.
- **Remote Monitoring & Management** became a first-class variation dimension: RDP, WinRM, rare binary, `net localgroup` and Windows LOLBIN rules each gained an RMM-actor variation.
- Smaller field moves: the AWS S3 public-exposure rule dropped its deduplication period from 5 days to 1, and the SSO-rejection rule now also reads OneLogin.

highlights.title: Remote Monitoring & Management tooling became its own detection dimension
highlights.detail: Five existing endpoint detectors each gained a variation that fires when the causality group owner is an RMM tool, raising severity from Informational to Low in every case.

highlights.title: Seven new AppleScript detectors target macOS infostealer behaviour
highlights.detail: They split what an AppleScript does into separate rules — keychain and SSH key access, crypto wallet data, Telegram and Notes data, screen and clipboard capture, obfuscated command lines, dscl-based password grabbing, and curl exfiltration to an external server.

highlights.title: The Email module lost both of its URL-popularity detectors
highlights.detail: "Unpopular domains detected in email URLs for a recipient" and "Rarely seen URL(s) within a well-known domain" were both withdrawn; both read Microsoft 365 Emails and carried the Malicious URLs tag.

highlights.title: A new analytics-enhanced detector correlates firewall vulnerability alerts with XDR data
highlights.detail: It fires on internal-to-internal vulnerability threat alerts that are rare for both the source host and the destination pair, and needs Palo Alto Networks Firewall threat logs alongside the XDR Agent.

highlights.title: The two net localgroup detectors were consolidated into one
highlights.detail: "Uncommon net localgroup execution" was deleted and its untrusted-CGO variation went with it; "Uncommon net localgroup command execution" survives and now also covers account creation under an RMM CGO.

highlights.title: OneLogin joins Okta as a source for the SSO rejection detector
highlights.detail: "A user rejected an SSO request from an unusual country" now lists both identity providers in its required data.

items.analytics/analytics-enhanced-rare-intern: New detector: an internal host triggers a firewall vulnerability alert against another internal host, rare for both. Needs PAN-OS threat logs plus the XDR Agent.
items.analytics/uncommon-applescript-designed-: New High-severity detector for AppleScript reaching into Telegram messages, Apple Notes or cached application data.
New Medium-severity detector for AppleScript touching keychains or SSH keys.
items.analytics/uncommon-applescript-potential: New detector for AppleScript password prompts; escalates to High when 'dscl -authonly' is used to silently verify the captured password.
items.analytics/uncommon-applescript-containin: New detector for obfuscated AppleScript command lines; High when launched by an uncommon parent process.
items.analytics/uncommon-applescript-was-execu: New detector for AppleScript contacting an external server, with variations for curl uploading a file or a .zip archive.
items.analytics/uncommon-applescript-designed-: New detector for AppleScript reading cryptocurrency wallet data; Medium once wallet files are actually accessed.
New detector for AppleScript performing screen capture (T1113) or clipboard access (T1115).
items.analytics/unpopular-domains-detected-in-: Withdrawn. Removes an Email-module phishing detector that read Microsoft 365 Emails.
items.analytics/rarely-seen-url-s-within-a-wel: Withdrawn. The companion Email-module detector for rare URLs inside otherwise well-known domains.
items.analytics/slack-connect-direct-message-i: Withdrawn. The Identity Threat Module loses its Slack Connect external-invite detector and both of its variations.
items.analytics/execution-of-an-uncommon-proce: Withdrawn. Removes a Generic Persistence Analytics detector for boot-time execution under a user SID.
items.analytics/uncommon-net-localgroup-execut: Withdrawn in favour of "Uncommon net localgroup command execution", which covers the same discovery behaviour.
items.analytics/applescript-process-executed-w: Variations reshuffled: persistence and proxy-install dropped; uncommon arguments (High) and muted audio output (Low) added.
items.analytics/aws-s3-bucket-was-exposed-to-p: Deduplication period cut from 5 days to 1, and the wording now covers exposing an object as well as a bucket.
